author: feenberg
body:
Taxsim does include the 2021 Additional CTC at the larger amount. The problem is that your txpydata.raw file includes a zero for one of the ages. That becomes 10 years old. Infants need to be shown as 1 year old after I  made that change, I get $9600 for the addititional ctc, which is what PE gets.. I would have to make a lot of code changes to undo this.

Also, I note that with idtl set to 5, PE shows zero for the number of dependent exemptions. I don't think that affects the tax calculation.  See

   http://taxsim.nber.org/out2psl/us4
